name: GenAI-Bench-800
description: GenAI-Bench-800 is a broad collection of 800 prompts/tasks designed to evaluate generative AI models across diverse capabilities including instruction following, reasoning, summarization, creative generation, and code snippets. It aims to stress-test general-purpose LLM behavior by providing a wide variety of task formats and difficulty levels. Evaluations combine automatic metrics where applicable and human judgments for open-ended outputs to assess overall model quality.
evaluation_method: human_eval and task-specific automatic metrics (accuracy, BLEU, F1, etc.)
general_score_metric: composite_score (combination of human evaluation and task-specific automatic metrics)
reputation: A relatively new, broad benchmark used for rapid, multi-task evaluation of generative models with modest community adoption.
